GalichonHenry2011 and standard LP/Farkas duality cover the generic certificate mechanism, though not this kernel polytope.
Nested-polytope compatibility radii are routine; the proposed rowwise-TV model is the only new ingredient.

repo_prior_art.cite: pid_slate_benefit_partialtransport concerns selected-complier partial transport, not multi-trial shared transition kernels.

WuMao2025, Assumption 5, Condition 3, and Corollary 2 identify all binary-state PSACEs under the exact common transition kernel and four-trial full-rank condition used by W* at d=0.
HsiaoTianParast2025 defines conditional-mean-function resilience probabilities and bounds, not a shared latent-row TV distance for PSACEs.
WeissmanEtAl2003 and projection-set inclusion yield the generic finite-sample mechanism; the augmented incompatible fiber is model-specific.
McCormick1976 gives generic relaxations, not exact face-complete profiling of these projected fibers.

novelty_flags.label: related_work / project_justification / thm:sharp-psace-endpoints
novelty_flags.one_line: The claim that the Wu--Mao ACCT attribution lacks a bibliographic record is false: WuMao2025 is an archival arXiv paper on ACCTs that identifies the same four-state joint law and PSACEs under invariant transition rows plus full rank.

novelty_flags.label: thm:strict-single-trial-improvement
novelty_flags.one_line: At d=0 the W* argument is the known exact common-transition/full-rank identification mechanism of WuMao2025 Corollary 2; its numerical witness does not make that theorem-level mechanism new.

novelty_flags.label: thm:sharp-psace-endpoints
novelty_flags.one_line: WuMao2025 is the closest published-axis comparator and is omitted despite matching the four-state ACCT setup, m>=4, common transition kernel, and PSACE target at d=0.

soundness_flags.label: symbol k_{gx} and def:robust-kernel-class
soundness_flags.one_line: k_{gx}=Pr(X(1)=z|X(0)=x,G=g) is undefined when mu_g^0(x)=0, yet the class quantifies and TV-constrains every such row; define primitive stochastic-kernel versions or restrict the conditional-law equality to positive-mass rows.

soundness_flags.label: thm:sharp-sign-radius
soundness_flags.one_line: The asserted equality to delta_sign and the all-trial minimum mostly unfold def:radius-objects; compactness and one LP establish attainment but do not yet make the sign-radius headline a substantive independent characterization.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:tv-drift / thm:sharp-psace-endpoints / thm:sharp-sign-radius
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The upper rowwise-TV radius is prespecified and not identified or empirically bounded by randomized-arm marginals.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Sharp endpoints and reversal radii are conditional on a chosen d and the shared rowwise-TV sensitivity model; rho* is only an observable compatibility lower bound.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 6 and 22--23, Proposition 2 and Proposition A.4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 2 gives the necessary condition NR>=3 for local identifiability; Proposition A.4 gives without-monotonicity, trial-specific PSACE bounds.
The paper assumes zero correlation of site-specific principal-stratum shares and effects, plus relevance and normalizations, to identify its principal causal effects.
The paper studies partial-identification regions under parametric principal-ignorability violations using same-sign and dominant-observed-effect restrictions.
The paper defines and estimates resilience probabilities, quantile bounds, and sets from distributions over deviating conditional-mean functions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 9--10, Assumptions 4--5, Condition 3, and Corollary 2; pp. 16--17, ACCT application
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For m>=4 and full-rank four-state control marginals, invariant transition probabilities G ⟂ (S(1),Y(1)) | (S(0),Y(0)) identify every joint four-potential-outcome distribution and PSACE; the paper applies the framework to ACCTs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add WuMao2025 as the primary d=0 comparator and state a theorem that the d>0 identified set strictly extends its exact-transportability model while remains nontrivially tighter than separate-trial bounds on a named observable class.
Repair zero-mass conditioning by defining k_{gx} as a primitive latent stochastic kernel and requiring its conditional-law interpretation only where mu_g^0(x)>0.
Replace the sign-radius definitional headline with an independent dual characterization, observable cut certificate, or a generic strict regime theorem comparing d=0, an interior d, and d=1.

recommended_next_step: Revise around the missed Wu--Mao comparator: make the d>0 partial-identification extension and a non-definitional sign-radius result the kernel, then re-run novelty review.
